properties.displayName: Kubernetes cluster pods should only use approved host network and port list
properties.description: Restrict pod access to the host network and the allowable host ports in a Kubernetes cluster. This recommendation is part of CIS 5.2.4 which is intended to improve the security of your Kubernetes environments and aligns with Pod Security Standards (PSS) for hostPorts. This policy is generally available for Kubernetes Service (AKS), and preview for Azure Arc enabled Kubernetes. For more information, see https://aka.ms/kubepolicydoc.

metadata.description: The source k8s object for constraint evaluation. 'Original' means only evaluate against the specific GroupVersionKind specified in the policy definition. 'Generated' means only evaluate against k8s objects generated by Gatekeeper ExpansionTemplates. 'All' means evaluate against both the original object and any generated ones.
Whether or not to return warnings back to the user in the kubectl cli
Start in audit mode. Only effects supported by the source definition are available.

List of Kubernetes namespaces to exclude from policy evaluation. System namespaces "kube-system", "gatekeeper-system" and "azure-arc" are always excluded by design. "azure-extensions-usage-system" is optional to remove.
List of Kubernetes namespaces to only include in policy evaluation. An empty list means the policy is applied to all resources in all namespaces.
Label query to select Kubernetes resources for policy evaluation. An empty label selector matches all Kubernetes resources.

schema.description: A label selector is a label query over a set of resources. The result of matchLabels and matchExpressions are ANDed. An empty label selector matches all resources.

matchLabels.description: matchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs.

matchExpressions.description: matchExpressions is a list of values, a key, and an operator.

key.description: key is the label key that the selector applies to.

operator.description: operator represents a key's relationship to a set of values.

values.description: values is an array of string values. If the operator is In or NotIn, the values array must be non-empty. If the operator is Exists or DoesNotExist, the values array must be empty.

metadata.description: Set this value to true if pod is allowed to use host network otherwise false.

The list of specific host ports that pods are allowed to use in the host network namespace. Can include individual ports (e.g., '80') or port ranges (e.g., '3000-5000'). Empty list means no host ports are allowed. Note that port 0 is not allowed according to Pod Security Standards.

The list of InitContainers and Containers to exclude from policy evaluation. The identifier is the image of container. Prefix-matching can be signified with `*`. For example: `myregistry.azurecr.io/istio:*`. It is recommended that users use the fully-qualified Docker image name (e.g. start with a domain name) in order to avoid unexpectedly exempting images from an untrusted repository.

Required public HTTPS URL of an organization-approved compatible Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate. The template must preserve the existing kinds, values and constraint contract. No versioned URL is supplied as a default; never infer a latest-version URL.

Required applicability decision: includedResourceIdPatterns must contain at least one approved ARM resource-ID pattern; excludedResourceIdPatterns must be supplied and may be empty. Each pattern is exact or uses at most one '*' wildcard, following Policy like semantics. No resource IDs or default scope are assumed. Patterns filter resources already within the assignment scope and never expand that scope.
